subject: Pilot slotting: clarifying SKU-level throughput & demo window

Subject: Interested in a quick pilot — self-serve signup done

Hi Markus,

I signed GreenBasket up via your self-serve flow earlier this morning and poked around the hosted API. We're evaluating Redwood for a short pilot to validate search suggestion latency at SKU-level and to compare per-token cost against our current provider.

High level: we're an e-commerce catalog and recommendations team (GreenBasket). Our immediate goal is a 2-week pilot to run representative traffic against Redwood's hosted endpoint and check tail latency + quality.

Can we set up a quick 30 minute pilot sync/demo this week or early next week? I'm happy to include a short CSV with recent traffic slices if that helps.

Thanks —
Derek Liu
Head of ML, GreenBasket
Derek Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

On Wed, Nov 12, 2025 at 09:12, Derek Liu <derek@greenbasket.ai> wrote:
> I signed GreenBasket up via your self-serve flow earlier this morning and poked around the hosted API.

Great to meet you, Derek — thanks for signing up and for the clear ask. Quick set of scoping questions so we can make the pilot productive:

- Primary use case: is this purely SKU search suggestion (query -> short suggestions) or do you also plan to use multi-turn chat/reranking for checkout personalization?
- Expected QPS and peak bursts (e.g., average 50 reqs/s, bursts to 400 reqs/s)?
- Average input + expected output token size (ballpark tokens per request).
- Do you need data residency / VPC-only connectivity during the pilot, or is hosted OK?
- Timeline: you mentioned ~2 weeks — does that mean live traffic for 2 weeks, or a 2-week evaluation window on replayed traffic?

I looped in Ben from SDR/cadence to propose real-time slots and Marissa from CS to own the calendar + invite and collect a brief traffic sample. I've attached a short pilot scope template you can fill out (pilot_scope_template.xlsx) — no need to be exhaustive; the fields are lightweight.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync to confirm scope and hand off keys/sandbox access. Ben will propose slots.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot_scope_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks Ben — Option B (Fri Nov 14, 11:30 AM ET) works for us.

Answers to Markus's questions so you have context before the call:
- Use case: primarily SKU search suggestions and short product-title completion (no multi-turn chat for the pilot). We'll also run a small rerank test for search result ordering.
- Expected traffic during pilot: baseline ~80 reqs/s with bursts up to ~350 reqs/s.
- Tokens: average input ~120 tokens, expected output ~60 tokens (so ~180 tokens total per request).
- Residency: hosted is fine for the initial pilot. If the pilot looks good we'll discuss Dedicated later.
- Timeline: we want to run live traffic sampling for two business days during the pilot and otherwise run replayed batches for the remainder — total evaluation window ~2 weeks.

I've uploaded a 1-week sample traffic slice and a small mapping doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cGreenBasketSampleTraffic (folder contains greenbasket_sample_traffic.csv). Please confirm you can access it; if not I can S3 presign.

See you Friday — looking forward to the checklist and the invite.

—Derek
